key_difference.original: Signal only on actual crossover event (momentum change detection)
key_difference.current: Signal on RSI position state (RSI merely above/below 50 and above/below MA)
key_difference.crossover_formula_original: rsiCrossUp = rsiPrev <= rsiMa && rsi > rsiMa\nrsiCrossDown = rsiPrev >= rsiMa && rsi < rsiMa
key_difference.simplified_formula_current: rsiPassBull = rsi > 50 && rsi > rsiMa\nrsiPassBear = rsi < 50 && rsi < rsiMa
key_difference.why_this_matters: A crossover represents a momentum change event - price moving from one RSI regime to another. Without the crossover requirement, any candle with RSI simply in the 'right' position generates a signal, including candles where RSI has been above 50 for many periods consecutively.

root_cause_visual.original_code_path: strategy.service.js detectSignal -> rsiCrossUp/rsiCrossDown -> rsiPassBull/rsiPassBear -> signal on crossover
root_cause_visual.current_code_path: backtest.engine.js calculateSignal -> rsi > 50 && rsi > rsiMa -> signal on position
root_cause_visual.change_summary: Removed rsiPrev comparison and crossover detection. Simplified RSI pass conditions from crossover-required to position-based.

key_difference.recommendation: Restore original RSI crossover logic in backtest engine to reproduce 38-trade baseline. Without this, trend-capture v2 should not proceed to TESTNET activation.
